rule: A 6-wide legend strip (background 8) on the left or right edge holds 3x3 glyphs, one colour each. On the background-0 canvas every 5x5 box swaps kind. A pattern box (a 2-frame with a 3x3 pattern of 1s) whose pattern equals a glyph up to rotation or reflection becomes solid in that glyph's colour. A solid box of a legend colour becomes a 2-frame with that glyph drawn inside in 1s, unrotated. The legend is unchanged.
scope: Match3x3 legend glyphs up torotation/reflection and swap patternboxeswithsolidcolourboxes; solidboxes redraw theoriginalunrotatedglyph. Default scenes retain same-cell-count distractors andnonidentity matches evenafterplacementretries.

authored_scope: Random mode samples the legend side, the glyph count, and the glyph shapes, drawn from all 8-connected full-bbox 3x3 masks of 4..7 cells and pairwise D4-distinct. It also samples colours, legend layout, the box lattice (1x1 up to 8 boxes), margins and gaps, the pattern/solid mix, orientations, and up to 2 distractor glyphs. Native size is 18x22 with 2x2 boxes. Heights 12..30 and widths 18..30 are synthetic extensions. Each random scene contains a pattern box in a non-identity orientation whose glyph shares its cell count with another glyph. When a solid box exists, at least one solid glyph is not fully D4-symmetric. Not supported: other frame, pattern, legend or background colours; a legend on the top or bottom edge; box sizes other than 5x5; glyphs other than 3x3; solid colour-2 boxes in random mode. Explicit mode reconstructs the fixtures and accepts any full-bbox glyph.
authored_constraints: Colour 0 is strictly most common and colour 8 strictly second. The cell budget 6h - 25p - 1 >= sum over glyphs of cells * cost guarantees count(8) > count(2), where cost is 1 for a non-pattern glyph plus 1 for glyph 2.
Glyphs are pairwise distinct up to rotation and reflection, and each has a full 3x3 bounding box, so every pattern matches exactly one glyph.
The legend has a fully-8 row and an 8 in every row and column. A column of 8 always separates the glyphs from the canvas.
Boxes never overlap or touch each other (including diagonally), the grid edge, or the legend.
At least one pattern box exists. Every box changes, so no sample is an identity.
In random mode colour 2 is never a solid box colour; when 2 is a box colour it is a pattern box.
Numeric controls must be real ints (no bool or float); random-only controls cannot be combined with explicit glyphs/boxes.
